models.notes: Engines: 1.2 DIG-T 115, 1.6 DIG-T 163 (from Jan 2015), 1.5 dCi 110 and 1.6 dCi 130 to Jun 2018; then 1.5 dCi 115 (Jul 2018), 1.3 DIG-T 140/160 (Sep 2018) and 1.7 dCi 150 (Jan 2019). Facelift on sale Jul 2017. UK sales began early 2014 (Parkers: available new from Jan 2014; Wikipedia: on sale Feb 2014) with the 1.2 DIG-T as the only petrol. Xtronic CVT on the 1.2 DIG-T and FWD 1.6 dCi; 1.6 dCi ALL-MODE 4x4-i manual only. 7-speed DCT on the 1.3 DIG-T 160 (from Nov 2018) and 1.5 dCi 115 (from Dec 2018); the 1.7 dCi automatic is the 4WD Xtronic CVT. Acenta continued with the new engines until Nov 2018; the 2018-20 core grades were Visia, Acenta Premium, N-Connecta, Tekna and Tekna+. Parkers' last diesel, Visia and Tekna derivatives end Oct 2020; the Oct 2020 to Apr 2021 run-out was 1.3 DIG-T only (Acenta Premium, N-Connecta, N-Motion). Other grades and editions listed by Parkers: Premier Limited Edition (Jan-Mar 2014), N-Tec (Oct 2014-Jan 2016; N-Tec+ listed alongside), Black Edition (Jul-Oct 2016), N-Vision (Oct 2016-May 2017), Pilot One Edition (Mar-Jun 2018), N-Motion (Dec 2018-Apr 2021) and a second N-Tec (Dec 2019-Oct 2020). Parkers lists Acenta+ (1.2 DIG-T, 1.5 dCi) and N-Tec+ derivatives without dates of their own. Bose Personal Edition (from earlier research) is not in Parkers' UK derivative list. Qashqai+2 not offered in this generation.
